sections.title: Sound of the letter zhe
paragraphs: The letter is called (жэ) /ʒɛ/. Its main sound is a consonant heard in (жук) /ʐuk/, which means beetle. This letter makes two sounds in Russian words.

sections.title: How to say zhe
paragraphs: Raise your tongue tip just behind the upper teeth ridge and pull it back slightly. Push air through the narrow space. For the first sound, turn your voice on. Touch your throat to feel the buzz. For the second sound, keep the same mouth shape, but turn your voice completely off.

sections.title: Reading the letter zhe
paragraphs: This letter makes its voiced sound before vowels, as heard in (жар) /ʐar/. It also keeps this voice before voiced consonants. At the end of a word, it loses its voice, as in (муж) /muʂ/. It also becomes voiceless before voiceless consonants, as shown in (ложка) /ˈloʂkə/.

sections.title: Common mistakes with zhe
paragraphs: Do not make the soft sound of s in measure. The Russian sound is harder and deeper. Pull your tongue tip further back and curl it up slightly. Never push your tongue flat against the roof of the mouth. Keep the lips pushed forward.
